title: Finite free limit of normalized free stalk towers
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, A its recorded valuation ring and p its uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let F be a tower of A-modules with F_n isomorphic to (A/(p^(n+1)))^r_n. Assume each adjacent transition is surjective with kernel p^(n+1)F_(n+1). Its compatible-sections module and its categorical inverse limit are finite free A-modules; the two are canonically A-linearly isomorphic.

proof.text: Apply the finite normalized module limit theorem to obtain finite generation of compatible sections.

Over the DVR, a class killed by p in A/(p^(n+2)) is a multiple of p^(n+1): lift to A and cancel nonzero p. Apply the finite-free coordinate isomorphism at level n+1. The transition kills all p^(n+1) multiples, so a compatible family killed by p has zero n-th component for every n. Every nonzero scalar is a unit times a power of p, so this limit is torsion-free. Finite torsion-free modules over the DVR are free.

The projections from compatible sections form a limiting cone: any cone sends x to its tuple of projected elements; uniqueness is coordinatewise. Transport finite generation and freeness through the resulting limit isomorphism.

theorem normalized_tower_finite_free (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hf : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty
      (F.obj (op n) ≃ₗ[coefficientExtensionIntegers l E]
        (Fin r → coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))
    (ht : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Function.Surjective (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op).hom ∧
      LinearMap.ker (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op).hom =
        coefficientExtensionIdeal l E (n + 1) •
          (⊤ : Submodule (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (F.obj (op (n + 1))))) :
    Module.Finite (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (ModuleCat.sectionsSubmodule F) ∧
      Module.Free (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (ModuleCat.sectionsSubmodule F)
